args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is vulnerable to CVE-2026-31337 (high severity):
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The fix is
to upgrade to >= 2.9.4 within the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Security rationale
CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. fastjson <2.9.4 is affected; 2.9.4 is the fixed version in the 2.x line. Upgrading within the same minor series avoids other breaking changes.

## Testing
CI run on this branch passed (all tests green).

## Requested reviewer
@alex

Per policy, merging into main requires code-owner approval, so the PR is now awaiting review from alex.
